headline: Reviewed 104 provisional ballots from the September 9, 2026 primary; 52 were disqualified.
summary: The meeting reviewed provisional ballots cast in the September 9, 2026 primary. Of 104 ballots, 52 were disqualified, 21 were federal ballots only, and 31 were full ballots. The minutes record no vote.
